reviews.title: This is the ONE. Look no further!
reviews.text:
I don’t write reviews usually but—in my opinion, this app deserves some public commendation. 

TEN YEARS I’ve been using this app now; I just checked. (Strangely, to the month! So call this my ‘decade anniversary’ review.) 

I always just used it on my phone—back in the day they were still working on coding technology for syncing so I would’ve had to buy it again for my iPad, and I wasn’t messing with that—but it never mattered because having it in one place was all I needed. It’s always been simple and worked perfectly, and been incredibly useful. 

There’s a feature on iPhone where the entries you visit most often gain an extra-crinkly sound when you click on them, emanating an older, used-paper effect like a physical journal in a favorite spot. It’s extra, small and thoughtful details like that which attracted me from the get, and kept me coming back all these years.  

The developers deserve kudos for not abandoning this app over time, and instead, kept it alive and improved it to thrive! I’m writing this on my iPad after adding the app here finally; in less than a few minutes I was looking at my entire ‘catalogue’ on the screen, populating itself without me even asking for it. In other words: the app in entirety works seamlessly, including especially the iCloud backup function. At times in the last decade there were gaps in my usage, sometimes a year maybe, and I used to be afraid my stuff would be gone … but it never was! Not even once. 

TLDR: In summary—this is the ONE. Get this app. I’ve had it since 2014 and it’s always stayed dependable, simple, useful… and it’s hard to improve on perfection but they did it—over the years—but without overdoing it. It syncs perfectly so you’ll never lose your stuff, you can attach endless pictures to each day if you want, and seeing your mood patterns as an overview can be really helpful and insightful. 

Thank You for Ten Years, My Wonderful Days! I appreciate you.
